steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Wow, it looks amazing! Hey blondie, you can be useful sometimes!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Little clapper, come and take a look!
Hearing OwO's call, you walk over with the dolls in your hands.
The stage before you is surprisingly exquisite. Seeing your expression, OwO lifts her chin proudly, arms akimbo.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe, so? I'm pretty talented, aren't I?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Impressive, indeed. I didn't expect you to pull it off so well.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It was all my work. Stop taking the credit!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ah, you're done with your dolls too, Chief!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Great job, Chief! They are just perfect. Our little theater will sure be a smash hit at the gala! It'll win the audience's hearts!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Oh! A smash hit! Win the audience's hearts!
OwO and Roulecca drag the slumped EMP onto the stage energetically and start planning with the dolls. Their happiness is infectious, and you find yourself smiling too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
